customization.summary: Inventory covers self-hosted Apache-2.0 OpenSandbox Docker/Kubernetes and separate managed AgentRun. OCI images/resources/network/storage depend on backend; managed AgentRun custom images documented but upstream API parity/GPU sandbox availability not verified. No repo adapter or run.

features.notes: OpenSandbox OCI image.uri/auth; managed AgentRun overview explicitly supports custom sandbox images. Managed image constraints not exhaustively verified; not proof of identical API.
Dependencies can be baked into custom images; runtime installation depends on permissions and egress. No managed live-pip execution verified.
OpenSandbox resourceLimits.cpu supports quantities e.g. 500m. Backend quota/template/admission determine capacity. Managed AgentRun sandbox CPU range not verified.
OpenSandbox resourceLimits.memory supports 512Mi/1Gi style quantities. Backend limits apply; managed sandbox RAM tiers unverified.

Official OpenSandbox ResourceLimits schema describes gpu device counts. Requires compatible backend mapping, GPU nodes/device integration/isolation and image; not universal Docker/Firecracker support. AgentRun model-runtime GPU is not managed sandbox GPU evidence; latter unknown.

OpenSandbox policy/enforcement deployment-dependent: Docker sidecar requires bridge and config, DNS mode not CIDR enforcement; IPv6 gaps. AgentRun VPC/PrivateLink does not prove upstream per-sandbox egress-schema parity.
OpenSandbox host/PVC/OSSFS volumes and backend snapshots; pool-mode storage configured in template. AgentRun OSS/NAS documented. Rootfs/session alone not indefinite durable storage.
OpenSandbox sandbox ID/lifecycle renew and backend-specific pause/resume; AgentRun file/session management. Rootfs snapshot not generic memory checkpoint; no repo multiturn run.
OpenSandbox commands.run shell documented. Managed AgentRun chosen image/tool/API governs shell availability; no blanket upstream interface inheritance.
OpenSandbox file SDK/API and managed AgentRun file management documented; exact managed file transport limits unverified.
OpenSandbox port endpoint with configured ingress/proxy. Managed Browser CDP/WebSocket specific to browser; not general public preview guarantee.
OpenSandbox self-hostable on Docker/Kubernetes, including configured isolation profiles; managed AgentRun backend not thereby self-hostable.
No native sandbox CMEK API or managed AgentRun sandbox key coverage verified. Infrastructure/storage encryption choices are distinct.

pricing.model: OpenSandbox has no software usage license fee; infrastructure paid separately. Managed AgentRun sandbox tariff unknown. FC standard CU reference rates below are independently sourced underlying-service prices, not verified managed sandbox quote; model inference separate.

pricing.limitations: FC reference rates do not prove AgentRun sandbox tariff. Promotion 2024-08-27 to 2026-08-27 ended before review; standard rates quoted. FC hourly settlement/CU rounding/$0.01 active function-hour minimum, CPU on-demand 1ms vs provisioned 10s and GPU 1s metering documented. FC sources differ on GPU coefficients/disk free quotas, so no managed GPU/storage quote inferred. OSS/NAS/CDT/registry/logging/model costs separate. No measured bills or comparable dated increase claim.
